name: animated-circular-progressbar
blurb: Animated circular progress bar with customizable colors, stroke width, and duration.
description: An SVG-based circular progress indicator with configurable primary and secondary colors, stroke width, optional percentage display, and animation duration.
use_when: Displaying progress in circular format with control over visual appearance and animation speed.
avoid_when: When a linear progress bar is more appropriate or when visual customization isn't needed.
a11y: Optional percentage text is displayed; the SVG itself lacks aria labels.
